If EthTrcv_GetCableDiagnosticsResult is called, the current state of the cable diagnostic measurement of the affected Ethernet transceiver shall be returned and stored per Ethernet transceiver as internal cable diagnostic state.

As long as the cable diagnostic measurement is running (in- ternal cable diagnostic state is ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING), a mode request (indicated by EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode) and link request (indicated by EthTrcv_ TransceiverLinkStateRequest), respectively, shall be stored and not executed.

As soon as the cable diagnostic meassurement has finished (internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING), EthTrcv shall execute the last mode request and link request, respectively, of the af- fected Ethernet transceiver.

If EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode() is called and the internal cable diagnostic state is equal to ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall store the mode request per EthTrcv (TrcvIdx).

If EthTrcv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest() is called and the internal cable diagnostic state is ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall store the link state request per Ethernet transceiver and pro- ceed as specified in [SWS_EthTrcv_00162].
